headers.//: PASS 3: index.html must NEVER be cached. Without no-cache, browsers serve a stale shell that points to deleted hashed asset URLs after a deploy → blank page until manual refresh.
PASS 3: Hashed asset filenames are immutable — content hash changes when content changes. Safe to cache for 1 year with `immutable` so browsers never revalidate.
Hashed image / font assets — same immutable strategy.
PASS 3: Security headers for ALL responses. The CSP in index.html still applies as a fallback for environments that ignore HTTP headers, but HTTP headers are the canonical place.
Strict-Transport-Security: force HTTPS for 2 years, include subdomains, allow preload.
Disable MIME-type sniffing — eliminates XSS via type confusion.
Disallow framing — prevents clickjacking attacks. Firebase Auth iframes for popup login are same-origin so this is safe.
Don't leak the URL on cross-origin navigation.
Disable browser features the app doesn't use.
headers.value: camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=(), payment=(), usb=(), bluetooth=(), magnetometer=(), gyroscope=(), accelerometer=(), midi=(), interest-cohort=()

headers.//: Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy: same-origin-allow-popups required for Firebase Auth popup flow. Without this, signInWithPopup hangs in some browsers.

emulators.//: Pass 8: Local emulator config for rules tests. CI workflow runs `npm run test:rules` which spins up the firestore emulator, runs vitest, then tears down.
